selection_rule.domain: ACTIVE H2 target with observed root actions; other supported inherited cases fall back to original selector
selection_rule.challenger: largest same-cache q_upper over other legal root actions; lexicographic action tie
selection_rule.signed_reach: math.fsum of empirical incumbent probabilities minus challenger probabilities for each common H1 successor
selection_rule.eligible: retained ACTIVE H1 state, nonzero signed reach, unobserved legal action with q_upper > state lower
selection_rule.fallback: original structural select_row, then inherited balanced repeat selection

partition_seed_rule: row_seed(partition_seed*1000000+suffix_base_seed,key,action); query and root-board identity excluded so identical retained row/counts use the same partition
partition_rule: For each observed ACTIVE H1 row, sort integer outcomes by successor/reward; uniformly sample N/2 multiset entries without replacement with random.Random(row_seed).sample(population=outcome indices,counts=integer_counts,k=N//2). Fold B is pooled counts minus fold A. A single-outcome row is divided exactly in half. No new environment draws.
h1_rule: Each fold uses the original legal-action and observed-row mask, empirical terminal values and query reward. Unknown actions keep the original structural lower bound. Each fold selects exact argmax then lex. Vcross=0.5*math.fsum((QB[argmax QA],QA[argmax QB])). Terminal values remain unchanged.
root_rule: Observed root rows keep original full-sample probabilities and rewards, backed up with Vcross; unknown root rows keep original structural lower bounds. Select exact numerical argmax and lex tie. Do not use tolerance for ranking or replace the frozen arithmetic with an algebraically equivalent path.
deployment_policy: Only change the H2 target action; retain all original pooled H1 execution actions and original profile/observation coverage. Original lower/upper fields remain labeled retained pooled values, not candidate confidence bounds.
baseline_rule: Extract original pooled root scores/action and verify against retained state/V35; inherit already validated original Vpi instead of re-evaluating it.
primary_eligibility: Whole suffix stream requires all 160 pairs source-valid, baseline reproduced, frozen candidate policies evaluable and V27 identities/reach valid. Missing policies stay unavailable; no oracle completion, no replacement endpoints or split seeds. Source-valid cost stream is independent of quality availability.
primary_unit: One retained suffix stream, averaging ten queries within each of sixteen fixed boards; paired pointwise 95% Student t Monte Carlo intervals conditional on original boards, prefixes and adaptive acquisition protocol plus the frozen partition rule.
cost_policy: Report actual current postprocess_seconds and paired difference; CROSSFIT includes partition and fold/root readout. Preserve original CACHED32 independent_query_seconds and all original three-configuration costs. Optional original cost plus current postprocess is a booked total, not contemporaneous online runtime. Restore/source checks, file I/O, oracle/evaluation/serialization are separate diagnostic work. Historical V36/V37 diagnostic accounts retained; no physical cost counted twice.
closure_policy: Read original endpoint stream exactly once; write all 2560 compact candidate proposals and V27 minimum retained-policy inputs before building any evaluation oracle. Re-read only the new proposal stream to evaluate candidates.
decision: Test one estimator change. No additional partitions, seed search, GAP/K tuning, or further oracle-removal analysis. Improvement requires paired full-policy results and complete cost accounting; lower cross-values alone are not evidence of improvement.
evidence_scope: A non-overlapping partition of retained adaptively acquired counts is not independent unbiased data. This is endpoint policy postprocessing on exposed histories, not a validated online allocation method or a new independent cohort. U005 FAIL unchanged.
